summary: Prompt 8E Lot C — Public page /public: full E2E validation. Public route accessible WITHOUT authentication (no redirect to login). All sections render (public-page, public-events, public-pros with QR, public-gallery, public-share-button). Backend endpoint GET /api/public/page returns enabled=true and 2 demo pros. Bureau admin controls in /admin/settings work: toggling show_pros OFF removes the section on /public; toggling enabled OFF renders the public-disabled state; reactivation restores everything. Shareable link matches {origin}/public. All state persisted across reloads.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: on /public (unauthenticated), the app makes background calls to authenticated endpoints (likely /api/auth/me from a global provider) producing 401 in console. Benign but noisy — main agent could gate those calls on presence of a session/token so the public page is truly silent.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing DEMO pros (Camille Dubreuil, Julien Marchais).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lot C validated. Public page toggles restored to enabled=true, show_events=true, show_pros=true, show_gallery=true at the end of the test as required.
